questions.prompt: A ball's height is h(t) = -16t² + 48t feet after t seconds. Factor h(t), and use the factors to say when the ball is at ground level.
questions.prompt_markup:
A ball's height is h(t) = -16t² + 48t feet after t seconds.
Factor h(t), and use the factors to say when the ball is at ground level.
questions.correct_answer: h(t) = -16t(t - 3); the height is 0 at t = 0 seconds (when it is thrown) and t = 3 seconds (when it lands).
questions.grading_note: Form required: the factored form and both times.

questions.prompt: Sketch a rough graph of f(x) = (x - 2)²(x + 1). Mark the zeros and the y-intercept, and show what the graph does at each zero. (Use the grid for x; the y-scale is up to you.)
questions.prompt_markup: Sketch a rough graph of f(x) = (x - 2)²(x + 1). Mark the zeros and the y-intercept, and show what the graph does at each zero. (Use the grid for x; the y-scale is up to you.)
questions.correct_answer: A curve that crosses the x-axis at -1, touches it at 2 and turns back up (double zero), passes through (0, 4), falls to the left and rises to the right
questions.grading_note: Any correct sketch: a crossing at -1, a touch at 2 (even multiplicity), y-intercept 4, and cubic end behavior.

questions.prompt: Graph f(x) = (x + 1)(x - 2)(x - 4). Mark the zeros and the y-intercept, and show the end behavior. (Use the grid for x; the y-scale is up to you.)
